verdict.rationale: A tax filing and payment portal could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled or recurring payments or filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off, user-initiated online filing and payment (including EFT), plus a portal that works only behind an authenticated interactive session. There is no documented recurring schedule, automation setup, or API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
